description: This file defines the EmployeeTimesheetMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface within the OrangeHRM Time module. Its purpose is to configure the menu for the employee timesheet section by overriding the screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet'.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for employee timesheet, overriding the default screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet' within the provided Screen object.
